basic_info.institution: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (Department of Rice, Centre for Plant Breeding and Genetics, Coimbatore)

drought.details: No evidence found in the searches for drought tolerance in CO 51.

heat.details: A heat-escape study uses the CO 51 background as the target for an early-morning-flowering version, aimed at reducing heat-induced yield loss. The digest does not report a measured heat tolerance level for CO 51 itself, so no level is assigned.

salinity.details: A salinity study tested endophytic and rhizospheric microbes on CO51 and PB1 for salinity-stress alleviation. This is a microbe study, not a varietal salinity tolerance trial, so it is not used as evidence of tolerance.

flood.details: No evidence found in the searches for flood tolerance in CO 51.

disease_resistance.summary: Blast: moderately resistant (TNAU 2013 release booklet; artificial screening reported in the 2019 EJPB paper). Blast: listed as resistant by TNAU technologies page and AICRIP Coimbatore centre report. Conflicting evidence: a marker-assisted study from a CO 51 x 562-4 cross reports CO 51 itself as susceptible on blast. Bacterial blight: listed as resistant on the TNAU technologies page (multiple resistance to blast, BPH and bacterial blight); no independent screening result for CO 51 in the digest. Brown Plant Hopper: listed under pest resistance below.

pest_resistance.summary: Brown Plant Hopper (BPH): moderately resistant under artificial screening (TNAU 2013 release booklet and EJPB 2019 paper); also listed as resistant on the TNAU technologies page and AICRIP Coimbatore report. Green Leaf Hopper (GLH): moderately resistant (TNAU 2013 release booklet and EJPB 2019 paper).

agronomic_details.yield: Mean yield over seven years of trials: 6623 kg/ha, 10.72% above ADT 43. Highest recorded yield: 11,377 kg/ha at Nallampalli, Dharmapuri district.
agronomic_details.stability: Tested over seven years of multi-location trials; the digest reports the mean yield advantage over ADT 43 but gives no separate stability statistic (e.g., GxE or stability index).
agronomic_details.adaptation: Tamil Nadu. Released as a Tamil Nadu paddy variety; farmer adoption reported in the Cauvery delta kuruvai season (see farmer adoption below). Other agro-climatic data not found in searched sources.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Semi-dwarf stature, efficient tillering, long droopy panicles. Grain: medium-slender white rice, milling about 69%, head rice recovery 63%, intermediate amylose (22%).
agronomic_details.field_trials: (1) MLT trials at TNAU stations, 2009 to 2012. (2) AICRIP IVT/AVT trials, 2009-2010. (3) Adaptive trials at 127 farmer locations in 17 districts, 2010-12. Results: seven-year mean yield 6623 kg/ha, 10.72% above ADT 43; highest recorded yield 11,377 kg/ha at Nallampalli, Dharmapuri district. Market quality: trader samples classed as a 'CO 51 type' carry a low premium; ADT 43 and TKM 15 are suggested as alternates (source: doaj.org article, authors not shown). Farmer adoption: an account reports about 40% of kuruvai-season area in the Cauvery delta under CO 51 within two years of release (citing Ramasamy 2015); this is a secondary account and is not independently verified in the digest.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: Not found in searched sources (no SNP or SSR marker names or positions for CO 51 in the digest). Marker-assisted backcrossing was used to develop early-morning-flowering NILs of CO 51.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: qEMF3 is carried by early-morning-flowering NILs of CO 51 developed by marker-assisted backcrossing; 19 BC3F2 progenies were homozygous for it. Effect size not reported in the digest. Pyramiding of Pi9, Pi54, xa13, Xa21, Gm1 and Gm4 into CO 51 backgrounds was carried out, with RILs and BILs screened for blast and bacterial blight; quantitative effects not reported in the digest.
genetics_and_breeding.molecular_mechanisms: Not found in searched sources beyond the listed resistance genes (Pi9, Pi54, xa13, Xa21, Gm1, Gm4) and the qEMF3 locus.

commercial_info.seed_corporations: Not found in searched sources (no National Seeds Corporation, State Seed Corporation or Seednet listing found; the Seednet portal was not reached). The search for seed availability was run once only.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST

Name check: The CSC name "CO 51" and the Seednet name "CO 51" are identical, so one set of searches covered both. The evidence refers to TNAU Rice CO 51 (IET 21605), also written CO(R) 51, a Tamil Nadu paddy variety. The input release date of 2014-10-20 does not match the sources, which give 2013 as the release year. Under this crop, the Seednet portal itself was not reached, so no Seednet-specific evidence was found.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Moderately resistant to Blast, Brown Plant Hopper and Green Leaf hopper (TNAU 2013 release booklet) -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/crop_improvement/variety_released/variety_release_2013.pdf
- Under artificial screening, the line is moderately resistant to blast, BPH and GLH -- https://www.ejplantbreeding.org/index.php/ejpb/article/view/1227
- A heat-escape study reports the CO 51 background as a target for an early-morning-flowering version, aimed at reducing heat-induced yield loss -- https://www.mdpi.com/2077-0472/13/3/553
- A salinity study tested endophytic and rhizospheric microbes on CO51 and PB1 for salinity-stress alleviation; this is a microbe study, not a varietal tolerance trial -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Distinguishing-morphological-characters-of-TNAU-Rice-CO-51CB-06-535_tbl1_334196659
- Drought, flood and submergence tolerance: No evidence found in the searches.

DISEASE AND PEST
- Multiple resistance to blast, BPH and bacterial blight is listed for CO 51 -- https://tnau.ac.in/site/cpbg/rice-technologies-developed/
- The AICRIP Coimbatore centre report describes CO 51 as resistant to blast and BPH -- http://aicrip-intranet.in/Documents/AicripSite/Centers/34%20Coimbatore.pdf
- Marker-assisted lines from a CO 51 × 562-4 cross were screened for bacterial blight and blast resistance, and CO 51 itself scored susceptible on blast in that study -- https://doi.org/10.3390/agriculture14050693

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Duration is 105–110 days, with semi-dwarf stature, efficient tillering and long droopy panicles -- https://www.scribd.com/document/490809354/3185-Article-Text-8180-1-10-20190617
- Mean yield over seven years of trials was 6623 kg/ha, 10.72% above ADT 43 -- https://ejplantbreeding.org/index.php/ejpb/article/view/1227
- Highest recorded yield was 11,377 kg/ha at Nallampalli, Dharmapuri district -- https://ejplantbreeding.org/index.php/ejpb/article/view/1227
- Testing covered MLT trials at TNAU stations from 2009 to 2012, AICRIP IVT/AVT trials in 2009–2010, and adaptive trials at 127 farmer locations in 17 districts in 2010–12 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/334196659_TNAU_Rice_CO_51_IET_21605_-_A_high_yielding_short_duration_fine_grain_rice_variety_for_Tamil_Nadu
- Grain traits: medium-slender white rice, milling about 69%, head rice recovery 63%, intermediate amylose (22%) -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/crop_improvement/variety_released/variety_release_2013.pdf

- Pedigree: derived from ADT 43 / RR 272-1745 (CB 06 535 line, F5 stabilised Rabi 2005) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/334196659_TNAU_Rice_CO_51_IET_21605_-_A_high_yielding_short_duration_fine_grain_rice_variety_for_Tamil_Nadu

drought.details: Described as an early duration, high-yielding drought tolerant rice variety for drought-prone districts of Tamil Nadu, derived from the cross PMK (R) 3 x Norungan. Listed under drought/moisture stress tolerant varieties in a Lok Sabha annex. TNAU 43rd Rice CSM (2024) records it as drought tolerant and suitable for direct seeding under rainfed and semi-dry conditions during the NEM period (September). A Journal of Rice Research study reported higher root length in CO 53 and Anna 4 under water stress, and it was identified as suitable for short-duration water stress conditions. The 2022 TNAU CSM proceedings note its drought tolerance in the context of induced drought stress evaluation at 55 DAS. Specific physiological mechanisms (e.g., root traits, osmotic adjustment) are only partly documented, mainly through the root-length observation.

heat.details: No variety-specific heat tolerance data for CO 53 found in the search results. Heat stress screening appears in the IIRR Annual Report 2020 and TNAU proceedings only as general program activity, not as CO 53 results.

salinity.details: No CO 53-specific salinity tolerance evidence found. A TNAU project on paddy diseases in saline soil is mentioned but not linked to CO 53 performance. Salinity is listed as a stress category in AICRIP proposals, without CO 53 results.

flood.details: The TNAU 41st CSM proceedings list CO 53 among varieties under observation for flood tolerance, but no tolerance rating or quantitative result is reported in the retrieved text.

disease_resistance.summary: Not specified for CO 53 in the retrieved results. Disease screening (stem rot, sheath rot) appears in IIRR program reports without variety-specific reaction data for CO 53.

pest_resistance.summary: Not specified for CO 53 in the retrieved results.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: No SSR, SNP, or QTL positions for CO 53 were found in the retrieved results. The PMC study on parental genetic diversity lists CO 53 among breeding parents but reports no marker details for it.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: No QTL effects specific to CO 53 were identified in the retrieved results.
genetics_and_breeding.molecular_mechanisms: Not specified. Drought tolerance is attributed to phenotypic evaluation and root traits rather than characterized genes or pathways.

disease_resistance.summary: Moderately resistant to stem borer, gall midge, blast, bacterial leaf blight (BLB), brown spot, sheath rot, sheath blight, rice tungro disease (RTD) and glume discoloration (TNAU CO 56 page). TNAU release list (2023) reports moderate resistance to multiple diseases and to stem borer and gall midge. An AICRPR trial table row for CO 56 lists moderate resistance to MR-BL, BLB, RTD, BS and SB. Note: the digest's abbreviations MR-BL, BS and SB are recorded as given; the IRM/MS score of 6.3 is recorded in field trials.

pest_resistance.summary: Moderately resistant to stem borer and gall midge (TNAU release list, 2023; also listed in the TNAU CO 56 page under the combined disease and pest list and in the AICRPR trial table as SB, and gall midge in the TNAU list). No quantitative pest score for CO 56 beyond the AICRPR notation was found.

agronomic_details.yield: Average grain yield 6372 kg/ha (TNAU CO 56 page and TNAU 2023 release list).
agronomic_details.stability: Not found in searched sources. The 2020 agronomy trial showed better agronomic efficiency than CO 52 (more grains per panicle and higher grain yield), but multi-environment stability was not reported.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Tamil Nadu (adaptation_ecology in record). Season listed as Late Samba / Thaladi (TNAU CO 56 page). AICRPR trial entry notes rainfed condition.
agronomic_details.maturity_days: 130 To 135Days (TNAU 2023 release list gives 130-135 days; TNAU CO 56 page gives 135-140 days; both recorded)
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Medium slender white rice; milling 67%; head rice recovery 64.1%; over 350 grains per panicle; medium-tall; non-lodging; high tillering ability.
agronomic_details.field_trials: (1) 2020 agronomy trial: CO 56 had better agronomic efficiency than CO 52, with more grains per panicle and higher grain yield (record agronomic_features). (2) TNAU CO 56 page and 2023 release list: average grain yield 6372 kg/ha; duration 130-135 days (2023 list) and 135-140 days (CO 56 page). (3) AICRPR trial table entry (IIRR Annual Report 2023): rainfed condition; IRM/MS scores of 6.3; moderate resistance scores as recorded under disease_resistance. No other trial results found.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: Not found in searched sources. Parentage (not a molecular marker): the TNAU page gives CO (R)50 / CB 05501, whereas the request record gives CB 01001/CB 05501 derivative (Kharif 2007, F5 stabilised). The request-record parentage is not confirmed by any source found; the TNAU parentage differs and should be reconciled.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: QTL/marker studies on CO 56: no evidence found. The MDPI study (Plants 12(2):250) covers the parent line CB12132 as a strong general combiner for filled grains per panicle and a useful donor for panicle traits; this is not a study of CO 56.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: CO 56 (CB12132 / IET27408 / IET 25531), rice

NAME NOTE: No Seednet (seednet.gov.in) page was returned by any search, so the seednet_variety_name "CO 56 (CB12132(IET27408& IET 25531)" is unverified. The evidence below refers to the release-minute name as it appears in press coverage of the notification, and to "CO 56" on TNAU pages. Both are the same variety.

STRESS TOLERANCE
Moderately resistant to stem borer, gall midge, blast, bacterial leaf blight, brown spot, sheath rot, sheath blight, rice tungro disease and glume discoloration -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/agriculture/CO%2056.html
Non-lodging with high tillering ability (TNAU release list, 2023) -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/pdf/New%20Varieties%20&%20Technologies%202023-15.02.2023%20-%20English-Final%20(1)%20(1).pdf
Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence tolerance: No evidence found for CO 56 specifically. A TNAU release table contains "Drought tolerant; Non lodging", but the row is not clearly attributable to CO 56, so it is not recorded here -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/crop_improvement/pdf/TNAU%20Variety%20release%20-%20Eng.pdf

DISEASE AND PEST
Moderately resistant to multiple diseases and to stem borer and gall midge (TNAU release list, 2023) -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/pdf/New%20Varieties%20&%20Technologies%202023-15.02.2023%20-%20English-Final%20(1)%20(1).pdf
Moderate resistance to MR-BL, BLB, RTD, BS and SB is listed in an AICRPR trial table row for CO 56 -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2023.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
Duration 135-140 days; season Late Samba / Thaladi; average grain yield 6372 kg/ha -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/agriculture/CO%2056.html
Duration 130-135 days; yield 6372 kg/ha; medium slender white rice, milling 67%, head rice recovery 64.1%; over 350 grains per panicle -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/pdf/New%20Varieties%20&%20Technologies%202023-15.02.2023%20-%20English-Final%20(1)%20(1).pdf
Medium-tall, non-lodging, high-yielding (TNAU technology list) -- https://tnau.ac.in/site/cpbg/rice-technologies-developed/
Entry in AICRPR trial table, with the notes "rainfed condition" and IRM/MS scores of 6.3 -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2023.pdf
Note: the TNAU lists give 135-140 days and 130-135 days; both are recorded above.

GENETICS AND QTL
Parentage per TNAU: CO (R)50 / CB 05501 -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/agriculture/CO%2056.html
Parentage per the request record (CB 01001/CB 05501 derivative, Kharif 2007, F5 stabilised) is not confirmed by any source found; the TNAU parentage differs and should be reconciled.
CB12132 is a strong general combiner for filled grains per panicle and a useful donor for panicle traits; this is a study of the parent line, not of CO 56 -- https://www.mdpi.com/2223-7747/12/2/250
QTL/marker studies on CO 56: No evidence found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Developing institution: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU), Coimbatore; the Department of Rice is the responsible unit -- https://tnau.ac.in/site/cpbg/rice-technologies-developed/
Lead breeder or scientist names: No evidence found in any source searched.
Release notification: Central Seed Committee, notified 25 September 2023 by Joint Secretary Pankaj Yadav, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare -- https://www.global-agriculture.com/india-region/indian-government-released-106-new-varieties-of-31-major-crops-for-farmers/
Open-pollinated variety, recommended for sale in Tamil Nadu -- https://www.global-agriculture.com/seed-industry/rice-variety-co-56-cb12132iet27408-iet-25531/
Date conflict: the record's year_of_release is 2023-05-02, but the notification date is 25 September 2023. The notification date is recorded here.

CONTACT DETAILS
Institute-level (no breeder contact found):
Professor and Head, Department of Rice, TNAU, Coimbatore 641 003; phone 0422-2474967; email rice@tnau.ac.in -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/pdf/2014/Seed_stock_position_12.2.2015_eng.pdf and https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/pdf/Seed%20Stock%20Position%20as%20on%2031.07.2021.pdf
Director (Seeds), Seed Centre, TNAU, Coimbatore 641 003; phone 0422-6611232; email seedunit@tnau.ac.in -- https://tnauseed.in/?Seeds=
Tamil Nadu Rice Research Institute, Aduthurai; phone 0435-2472108 / 2472098; email dirtrri@tnau.ac.in -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/pdf/Seed%20Stock%20Position%20as%20on%2031.07.2021.pdf
Note: the 2015 document lists a different Department of Rice phone number (04362-267680) for the same unit; the listed numbers should be verified.

PUBLICATIONS
No peer-reviewed paper on CO 56 itself was found.
AICRIP/ICAR: "All India Coordinated Research Project on Rice, IIRR Annual Report 2023" (ICAR-IIRR, 2023). Authors not listed in the captured text. Contains a CO 56 trial entry -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2023.pdf
Journal: "Identification of Newer Stable Genetic Sources for High Grain Number per Panicle and Understanding the Gene Action for Important Panicle Traits in Rice" (2023), Plants 12(2):250. Authors not captured. Covers the parent CB12132, not CO 56 -- https://www.mdpi.com/2223-7747/12/2/250
KrishiKosh theses and conference papers: No evidence found.

SEED AVAILABILITY
TNAU Seed Centre (Coimbatore) lists seed stock by centre, but the captured 2019-2022 stock lists do not show CO 56 -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/seed_certification/pdf/seedavailabilityon13.08.2019.pdf and https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/pdf/TNAU%20-%20Seed%20stock%20position%20as%20on%2002.09.2022%20-%20English.pdf
Current seed stock of CO 56: No evidence found.
State agency: TANSEDA, Chennai; phone 044-28524894; email coa.tanseda2017@gmail.com -- https://www.tnagrisnet.tn.gov.in/tanseda/
Seednet listing: No evidence found.

RECOMMENDED STATES

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: DEPARTMENT OF RICE, CENTRE FOR PLANT BREEDING & GENETICS, TNAU, COIMBATORE 641 003.
seednet_fields.Parentage: CO (R) 49 IS A HYBRID DERIVATIVE OF THE CROSS C 20/RNR 52147 EFFECTED DURING KHARIF 1996 AND STABILIZED IN F 4GENERATION DURING KHARIF 1999.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: IRRIGATED CONDITION AS A TRANSPLANTED CROP IN LATE SAMBA/ THALADI SEASON ( SEPT. - OCT. SOWING)
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: CO (R) 49 (CB 99019) WAS EVALUATED UNDER SRI SYSTEM OF RICE CULTIVATION IN RABI 2006--07 AT COIMBATORE. THE CULTURE RECORDED HIGHER GRAIN YIELD UNDER SRI THAN THE NORMAL METHOD AND ALSO OVER THE CHECK VARIETY, BPT 5204. NON LODGING NON SHATTERING HIGH TILLERING ABILITY SUITABLE FOR LATE SAMBA AND THALADI SEASON (SEP-OCT SOWING) AS TRANSPLANTED CROP IN TAMIL NADU. THE REICE VARIETY CO (R) 49 HAS MEDIUM SLENDER WHITE GRAIN TYPE WITH GOOD MILLING PERCENTAGE (72.3%) AND HEAD RICE. THIS VARIETY POSSESSES INTERMEDIATE AMYLOSE AND INTERMEDIATE GELATINIZATION TEMPERATURE WHICH ARE THE DESIRABLE TRAITS FOR GOOD COOKING QUALITY.
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: 1. EXERTED DROOPY COMPACT PANICLES 2. MEDIUM SLENDER WHITE RICE
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: PLANT HEIGHT : 85-90 CM, GOOD EARLY PLANT VIGOUR : GREEN, COLEOPTILE : GREEN, BASAL LEAF SHEATH COLOUR : GREEN, LEAF BLADE COLOUR: GREEN, LEAF PUBESCENCE INTERMEDIATE, LEAF LENGTH : 45.0 CM (+ 5.0 MM) LEAF WIDTH : 1.50 CM  (+ 0.2 MM) DAYS TO 50% FLOWERING : 100-105 DAYS PANICLE EXERTION : WELL-EXERTED PANICLE  DAYS TO MATURITY (DAYS) : 135  DAYS SEED ACOAT (KERNEL ) COLOUR : WHITE 1000 GRAIN WEIGHT (G) 15.9, GRAIN MEDIUM SLENDER RICE GRADE : MEDIUM SLENDER MILLED RICE COLOUR : WHITE ABDOMINAL WHITE : OCCASIONALLY PRESENT,
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: ABIOTIC -NOT TESTED BIOTIC- REACTION TO PESTS AND DISEASES FURNISHED IN PARA 12 (A) AND 12 (B)
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: THE CULTURE CB 99019 WAS SCREENED AGAINST ALL THE FIVE EPIDEMIC DISEASES VIZ., BLAST, BACTERIAL BLIGHT, SHEATH ROT, SHEATH LIGHT AND RICE TUNGRO DISEASE (RTD) UNDER ARTIFICIALLY INOCULATED CONDITIONS DURING 2004-05,2005-06 AND 2007 -08. THE CULTURE CB 99019 IS FOUND TO BE MODERATELY RESISTANT TO BLAST (5), BACTERIAL LEAF BLIGHT (5) AS AGAINST BPT 5204 (7&9)
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: THE CULTURE CB 99019 WAS EVALUATED FOR THREE YEARS (2005-08 ) AT COIMBATORE, MADURAI ANDADUTHURAI AGAINST THE MAJOR PESTS AND WAS FOUND TO BE MODERATELY RESISTANT TO YELLOW STEM BORER (3), GLH (3) AS AGAINST BT 5204 (7&9)

drought.details: CO(R) 49 is a drought tolerant rice variety, suitable for direct sown rainfed conditions. Its derivative, AD 13253, also shows tolerance to drought.

heat.details: CO(R) 49 has been included in studies that evaluate high temperature tolerance, sometimes as a check or a variety of interest. However, direct evidence of its inherent heat tolerance level is not explicitly stated.

salinity.details: A derivative of CO(R) 49, AD 13253 (AD 01246 / CO(R) 49), is reported to be tolerant to salinity stress through marker aided selection. CO(R) 49 is also studied in the context of paddy diseases in saline soil ecosystems and salt tolerance in rice.

flood.details: CO(R) 49 is reported to be tolerant to flood.

disease_resistance.summary: CO(R) 49 is moderately resistant to blast, Rice tungro virus, and sheath blight.

pest_resistance.summary: CO(R) 49 is resistant to stem borer and moderately resistant to hoppers.

agronomic_details.yield: Average yields reported for CO(R) 49 include 5592 kg/ha and 5830 kg/ha in different trials.
agronomic_details.stability: The variety has been evaluated in 110 yield trials. It recorded higher grain yield under the SRI (System of Rice Intensification) method than the normal method and also out-yielded the check variety, BPT 5204. It is described as a high yielding medium duration fine grain rice variety.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Suitable for late Samba and Thaladi season (September-October sowing) as a transplanted crop in Tamil Nadu. It is also suitable for direct sowing and rainfed conditions.
agronomic_details.maturity_days: 130-135 days, with some reports specifying 132 or 135 days.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: CO(R) 49 is a semi-dwarf variety (85-90 cm), non-lodging, non-shattering, with an erect plant type and high tillering ability. It has exerted droopy compact panicles and medium slender white grain type. The rice possesses good milling percentage (72.3%) and head rice, with intermediate amylose and intermediate gelatinization temperature, contributing to good cooking quality.
agronomic_details.field_trials: Evaluated under the SRI system in Rabi 2006-07 at Coimbatore. It recorded higher grain yield under SRI and surpassed the check variety, BPT 5204. It was used as a test variety for experiments including SRI marker and machine planting with a seed requirement of 8 kg/ha. It is also suited for direct seeded cultivation.

drought.details: CO(R) 49 is a drought tolerant rice variety, suitable for direct sown rainfed conditions. Its derivative, AD 13253, also shows tolerance to drought.

heat.details: CO(R) 49 has been included in studies that evaluate high temperature tolerance, sometimes as a check or a variety of interest. However, direct evidence of its inherent heat tolerance level is not explicitly stated.

salinity.details: A derivative of CO(R) 49, AD 13253 (AD 01246 / CO(R) 49), is reported to be tolerant to salinity stress through marker aided selection. CO(R) 49 is also studied in the context of paddy diseases in saline soil ecosystems and salt tolerance in rice.

flood.details: CO(R) 49 is reported to be tolerant to flood.

submergence.details: CO(R) 49 has been used as a parent (AD 13253 is AD 01246 / CO(R) 49) in research aimed at screening for submergence tolerance in rice genotypes. While other varieties are noted for submergence tolerance, direct evidence for CO(R) 49 itself being submergence tolerant is not explicitly provided.

disease_resistance.summary: CO(R) 49 is moderately resistant to blast, Rice tungro virus, and sheath blight.

pest_resistance.summary: CO(R) 49 is resistant to stem borer and moderately resistant to hoppers.

agronomic_performance.yield: Average yields reported for CO(R) 49 include 5592 kg/ha and 5830 kg/ha in different trials.
agronomic_performance.stability: The variety has been evaluated in 110 yield trials. It recorded higher grain yield under the SRI (System of Rice Intensification) method than the normal method and also out-yielded the check variety, BPT 5204. It is described as a high yielding medium duration fine grain rice variety.
agronomic_performance.adaptation: Suitable for late Samba and Thaladi season (September-October sowing) as a transplanted crop in Tamil Nadu. It is also suitable for direct sowing and rainfed conditions.
agronomic_performance.maturity_days: 130-135 days, with some reports specifying 132 or 135 days.
agronomic_performance.plant_characteristics: CO(R) 49 is a semi-dwarf variety (85-90 cm), non-lodging, non-shattering, with an erect plant type and high tillering ability. It has exerted droopy compact panicles and medium slender white grain type. The rice possesses good milling percentage (72.3%) and head rice, with intermediate amylose and intermediate gelatinization temperature, contributing to good cooking quality.
agronomic_performance.field_trials: Evaluated under the SRI system in Rabi 2006-07 at Coimbatore. It recorded higher grain yield under SRI and surpassed the check variety, BPT 5204. It was used as a test variety for experiments including SRI marker and machine planting with a seed requirement of 8 kg/ha. It is also suited for direct seeded cultivation.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
- Described as a salt-resilient, high-yielding rice variety; salinity tolerance is the main claim, but no drought, flood, submergence or heat data was retrieved -- https://www.psa.gov.in/livelihood/10131
- Listed as suited to irrigated alkaline/saline stress areas (snippet from a non-official blog; treat as secondary) -- https://agroconsultants.blogspot.com/2010/12/agroconsultancy.html

DISEASE AND PEST
- No evidence found (searched; no resistance data for blast, bacterial blight, sheath blight, BPH or other pests appeared in retrieved results)

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- No evidence found (no maturity duration, yield figures, or multi-location trial results retrieved; the PSA page's yield claim was not visible in the retrieved snippet)

GENETICS AND QTL
- Pedigree as supplied in the variety record: CROSS T 90 X URANG URANGAN (no independent confirmation found in retrieved results)
- Variety code CSR-389-16-22 / IET-30827 associated with the name CSR 101 in the blog snippet -- https://agroconsultants.blogspot.com/2010/12/agroconsultancy.html
- No QTL or marker study found

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institution: ICAR-Central Soil Salinity Research Institute (CSSRI), Karnal, Haryana -- https://www.psa.gov.in/livelihood/10131
- Lead breeder name: not found in retrieved results

CONTACT DETAILS
- Role: Director, ICAR-Central Soil Salinity Research Institute (developer contact listed on PSA page) -- https://www.psa.gov.in/livelihood/10131
- Email as found: director[dot]cssri[at]icar[dot]gov[dot]in (rendered with [dot]/[at] obfuscation; convert to director.cssri@icar.gov.in only after verifying on an official CSSRI page)
- Address as found: Zarifa Farm, Kachhwa Road, Karnal -- 132001, Haryana, India -- https://www.psa.gov.in/livelihood/10131
- Phone: not found

PUBLICATIONS
- No evidence found (no journal article, AICRP report, KrishiKosh thesis or conference paper was retrieved for CSR 101 / CR-1014)

SEED AVAILABILITY
- No evidence found for NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SAU or private dealer listings for CSR 101 or CR-1014 (the Seednet portal itself was not retrieved)

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Release record: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka -- supplied variety record (no independent source confirmed this list)
- Blog snippet instead lists Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka -- https://agroconsultants.blogspot.com/2010/12/agroconsultancy.html (conflicts with the release record on UP/Haryana vs Kerala; flag for verification)
- CR-1014 appears in a list of notified paddy varieties for Kerala, but the snippet does not show it mapped to CSR 101 -- https://www.global-agriculture.com/seed-industry/list-of-notified-paddy-varieties-for-kerala/

NAME MAPPING
- variety_name CSR 101 (CSC release minutes) and seednet_variety_name CR-1014 (Seednet): the evidence above refers mostly to CSR 101 / IET-30827. The only CR-1014 evidence is the Kerala list entry, which does not confirm identity.

LIMITATIONS
- The search budget was used up after the first batch of four queries, so the planned follow-up searches (breeder names, publications, seed sources) could not be run. Several headings are therefore thin. I did not check the release date (2 Aug 2024) against any notification gazette.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
CR Dhan 206 (Gopinath) EVIDENCE DIGEST

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Listed as an aerobic variety with tolerance to stem borer (dead heart and white ear), leaf folder, whorl maggot and rice hispa; moderately tolerant to gall midge biotype 1 -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- The 2019 NRRI list also records high tolerance to leaf folder, dead-heart stem borer and whorl maggot, and moderate tolerance to gall midge and white-ear stem borer -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Named among 13 CRRI/NRRI varieties with high water-use efficiency -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/NRRI_Research-Bulletin-No-55.pdf
- Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence: No evidence found for this variety. A salinity sentence on the released-varieties page is generic and not tied to this variety, so I did not attribute it.

DISEASE AND PEST
- Release list codes: "MR-LB, BS ShR, SB, LF" (3.95 t/ha). The abbreviations are not expanded on the page, so I have not interpreted them -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Specific blast or bacterial blight reaction for this variety: No evidence found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Release list: duration 115 days, plant height 105 cm, grain type SB -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Yield is inconsistent across NRRI pages: 3.95 t/ha in one list, 5.0 t/ha and 5.4-6 t/ha in others. Treat as unresolved -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- An aerobic-system release summary (2015) lists CR Dhan 206 with yield around 4.2 t/ha; the figure is truncated in the snippet -- https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/daily_events/2015/english/Sept/14_sep_15_eng.pdf
- Field trial reports specific to this variety: No evidence found.

GENETICS AND QTL
- Pedigree/variety code CR 2996-1-14-29-3-1 (IET 22731) given for CR Dhan 206 (Gopinath) in an NRRI analysis -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- Parentage: not stated in any source found.
- Variety-specific QTL or marker study: No evidence found. The CRRI Research Bulletin 58 covers QTLs generally and does not name this variety -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/CRRI-Research-Bulletin-58_compressed.pdf

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institution: ICAR-Central Rice Research Institute (now ICAR-National Rice Research Institute, NRRI), Bidyadharpur, Cuttack, Odisha -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/NRRI_Research-Bulletin-No-55.pdf
- Lead breeder or scientist names for this variety: No evidence found.
- Station: the variety is listed under the Cuttack headquarters, not a regional station -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

CONTACT DETAILS (institute-level; no breeder contact found)
- Director, ICAR-Central Rice Research Institute, Cuttack 753006, Odisha. Phone +91-671-2367757/67; EPBX +91-671-2367768-783; Fax +91-671-2367663; Email directorcrricuttack@gmail.com -- https://icar-crri.in/contact-us/
- Email director.nrri@icar.org.in with phone +91 671 236 7768 and address Bidyadharpur, Cuttack, Odisha -- https://www.facebook.com/riceicar/ (third-party-hosted page)
- Email director.nrri@icar.gov.in is listed on a third-party directory with Director phone 0671-2367757 -- https://www.indiacustomercare.com/national-rice-research-institute-nrri-contact-no-0671-236-7757 (not an official ICAR page; verify before use)
- Postal address: Cuttack 753006, Odisha, India -- https://icar-crri.in/contact-us/

PUBLICATIONS
- Pathak, H.; Chidambaranathan, P. (2020). Rice Varieties of NRRI: Yield, Quality, Special Traits and Tolerance to Biotic and Abiotic Stresses. Journal/report not stated -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- Author not stated (2024). Recent Rice Varietal Innovations at ICAR-NRRI (2022-2024), NRRI Research Bulletin No. 55 -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/NRRI_Research-Bulletin-No-55.pdf
- Peer-reviewed paper, thesis or KrishiKosh record on this variety: No evidence found.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- No evidence found from NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU or dealer sources for CR Dhan 206. The searches did not return a seed-sale page.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Odisha -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

SEEDNET NAME: CR DHAN-209
- The evidence found for "CR Dhan 209 (Priya)" refers to a different variety. It is an aerobic line released in 2016 for Odisha, with 112-115 days duration and 4.07 t/ha yield -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ . It is not CR Dhan 206 and I have not attributed any of its data to CR Dhan 206.
- No Seednet portal page for CR DHAN-209 or CR Dhan 206 was found.

NOTES
- Release year conflict: the CSC minutes date (2015-10-12) differs from the 2014 year in the ICAR-CRRI release lists. Verify against the CVRC/CSC notification.
- Name check: "Vl Dhan 206" (a Uttar Pradesh/Himalayan upland variety) and "CR Dhan 310/311" were excluded as different varieties.
- Search budget: four web searches were used, one per topic plus one extra for seed and contact.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: CR Dhan 204 (CSC release name) / CR DHAN-214 (Seednet portal name)

Name note: the CSC release record uses "CR Dhan 204" (released 2014). The Seednet portal name "CR DHAN-214" is a different variety. Its own evidence (2024 release, aerobic, 110 days) appears under the headings below. The seednet name is not the same release, so evidence for CR Dhan 214 is not evidence for CR Dhan 204. No Seednet portal page was found for either name.

Search budget: 4 web_search calls were used, one per topic plus one extra for seed availability.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- CR Dhan 204 (aerobic, 120 days, 2014 release, CVRC): listed as highly tolerant to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot, and moderately tolerant to gall midge biotype 1 and white-ear stem borer. Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence tolerance are not stated for this variety in the pages found. -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- CR Dhan 204: the same CRRI listing gives a yield range of 4.8-5.6 t/ha, though the table layout makes it unclear whether that range belongs to this row. -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- CR DHAN-214 (Seednet name; aerobic, 110 days, 2024 CVRC release): described as moderately resistant to leaf blast, sheath rot and rice tungro disease (RTD). No drought or other abiotic-stress data for this variety were found. -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- CR Dhan 204 root traits: in an aerobic-condition screening, CR DHAN-204 ranked among genotypes with superior root traits linked to drought tolerance, and it was field-tested at a Dharwad station. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/370992428_Screening_of_rice_Oryza_sativa_L_genotypes_for_root_characters_related_to_drought_tolerance_and_its_association_with_yield_under_aerobiccondition

DISEASE AND PEST
- CR Dhan 204: moderate resistance (MR) to leaf blast, neck blast, brown spot, sheath rot, stem borer, leaf folder and whorl maggot, per the release listing. -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- CR DHAN-214 (Seednet name): MR to leaf blast, sheath rot and RTD. -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- CR Dhan 204: aerobic type, 120 days (one NRRI-book table gives 126 days, a discrepancy). -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- CR Dhan 204 was included in 2017 cluster demonstrations of ICAR-NRRI varieties; the cluster demonstration page names only CR Dhan 202 and CR Dhan 305, not CR Dhan 204. No CR Dhan 204 trial result was found. -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/2904 (found but discarded for relevance)
- CR DHAN-214: only the release listing above; no trial data found.

GENETICS AND QTL
- CR Dhan 204 parentage: IRR76569-259-1-2-1 × CT6510-24-1-2 (also shown as CR2696-IR 83920 in one table). No QTL or marker study naming CR Dhan 204 was found. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/370992428_Screening_of_rice_Oryza_sativa_L_genotypes_for_root_characters_related_to_drought_tolerance_and_its_association_with_yield_under_aerobiccondition ; https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- CR DHAN-214: parentage not found. No evidence found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- CR Dhan 204 was developed by the Cuttack rice institute (listed as ICAR-NRRI in some pages and ICAR-CRRI in others; the same CR-prefix varieties appear under both names). -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- CR Dhan 204 is listed among the NRRI/Hazaribag upland (aerobic) releases. -- https://www.icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/RICE-VARIETIES-NRRI.pdf
- Lead breeder name: No evidence found.
- CR DHAN-214: listed among the 2024 releases and the institute's breeding pipeline. -- https://icar-crri.in/major-achievements/ ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

CONTACT DETAILS
- No evidence found. No breeder name, email, phone or address was found on a page naming CR Dhan 204 or CR DHAN-214. A Cuttack institute address appeared on a CR Dhan 407 paper, but that page names a different variety, so it was discarded. -- https://www.scielo.br/j/cbab/a/NQVPpC3bCvm6KtXQS4jzf8F/?lang=en (discarded)

PUBLICATIONS
- Journal of Cereal Research, vol. 15 (1), pp. 56-64. Title: "Screening of rice (Oryza sativa L.) genotypes for root characters related to drought tolerance and its association with yield under aerobic condition." Authors and year: not captured in the page text. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/370992428_Screening_of_rice_Oryza_sativa_L_genotypes_for_root_characters_related_to_drought_tolerance_and_its_association_with_yield_under_aerobiccondition
- ICAR-NRRI book "Rice Research for Enhancing Productivity, Profitability and Climate Resilience": names CR Dhan 204 only in variety tables; no separate study found. Authors and year not captured. -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/Rice_Research_book_nrri.pdf
- No KrishiKosh thesis, AICRP report or DOI naming CR Dhan 204 was found in these searches.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- No evidence found for CR Dhan 204 or CR DHAN-214 from NSC, state seed corporations, KVKs, SAU seed sales or private dealers. The state seed-availability list found named other varieties only. -- http://osscltd.in/cms/marketing/availability-of-seeds (discarded)

RECOMMENDED STATES
- CR Dhan 204: CVRC-recommended for Jharkhand and Tamil Nadu. -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- CR Dhan 204 was also noted as notified or recommended for Jharkhand in an NRRI variety list. -- https://www.icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/RICE-VARIETIES-NRRI.pdf
- CR DHAN-214 (Seednet name): CVRC-recommended for Odisha and Bihar. -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: CR Dhan 300 (CSC minutes name "CR Dhan 300"; Seednet name "CR DHAN-300")

Search coverage: 4 web_search queries were run (variety release/stress; breeder/institute/contact; research papers/QTL/trials; seed availability). No result returned under the Seednet name "CR DHAN-300", so all evidence below refers to "CR Dhan 300" (also listed as CR 2301-5, IET 19816).

STRESS TOLERANCE -- No variety-specific stress evidence found. The NRRI popular-varieties page has a stress block that appears to describe a different variety, so I did not attribute it to CR Dhan 300. Only the NRRI page's duration and ecology line is clearly CR Dhan 300. -- https://icar-crri.in/popular-nrri-varieties/

DISEASE AND PEST -- No variety-specific disease or pest evidence found. The same NRRI page contains resistance text that is ambiguous in attribution (see above). -- https://icar-crri.in/popular-nrri-varieties/

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- Medium-late duration of about 140 days, for irrigated/shallow lowland cultivation. -- https://icar-crri.in/popular-nrri-varieties/
AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- Listed as a CVRC-released irrigated variety with 2013 in the release table and duration 140 days (type "LS"). -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- Listed among varieties recommended for the Eastern and North Eastern zone in the 56th Annual Rice Research Group Meeting proceedings. -- https://icar-iirr.org/56%20ARGM%20Draft%20Proceedings%202021-%202.08.2021.pdf
AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- Yield data: No evidence found.

GENETICS AND QTL -- No evidence found. Parentage was not found in any result; the record field "Not specified" stays unresolved.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- Developed at ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack, Odisha (formerly CRRI). The NRRI release list includes CR Dhan 300 among its varieties. No individual breeder name was found. -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://icar-crri.in/popular-nrri-varieties/
BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- Notified under S.O. 1146(E), dated 25.04.2014, for Maharashtra, Odisha, Bihar and Gujarat. -- http://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Notified-Rice-Varieties.htm

CONTACT DETAILS -- No breeder contact found. Institute-level contact (Central Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, the predecessor name): Director, Central Rice Research Institute, ICAR, Cuttack (Odisha) 753006, India; Phone 91-0671-2367768-83; Fax 91-0671-2367663; E-mail director.crri@icar.gov.in; directorcrricuttack@gmail.com; contact page https://crri.icar.gov.in/ . Note that the institute's current name should be verified against the NRRI site, since the source pages use the older CRRI name. -- https://crri.icar.gov.in/

PUBLICATIONS -- Authors not identified (ResearchGate listing; year not confirmed): "Rice Varieties of NRRI: Yield, Quality, Special Traits and Tolerance to Biotic and Abiotic Stresses." Journal/report not identified. CR Dhan 300 appears in its variety list. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
PUBLICATIONS -- Proceedings of the 56th Annual Rice Research Group Meeting (2021) mention CR Dhan 300 in a zone-recommendation context; authors and full citation not identified. -- https://icar-iirr.org/56%20ARGM%20Draft%20Proceedings%202021-%202.08.2021.pdf
PUBLICATIONS -- Peer-reviewed papers, KrishiKosh theses, and AICRP trial reports specific to CR Dhan 300: No evidence found.

SEED AVAILABILITY -- No NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SAU or Seednet listing for CR Dhan 300 found. The only seed result was a generic private retail listing for hybrid paddy, which is not this variety. -- https://www.flipkart.com/hybrid-paddy-paddy-seeds-paddy-fi-paddy-dhaan-beej-dhan-seed-price-in-india

RECOMMENDED STATES -- Odisha, Bihar, Gujarat and Maharashtra (irrigated/shallow lowland). -- https://icar-crri.in/popular-nrri-varieties/ ; http://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Notified-Rice-Varieties.htm
RECOMMENDED STATES -- Eastern and North Eastern zone listing. -- https://icar-iirr.org/56%20ARGM%20Draft%20Proceedings%202021-%202.08.2021.pdf

RECORD FIELD NOTES -- Institution: ICAR-NRRI/CRRI, Cuttack (replaces "Not specified"). Recommended states: as above (replaces "Not specified"). Release year: the metadata says 2014-02-14; the Bihar notification gives 2014 (S.O. dated 25.04.2014); the CRRI table says 2013. Verify against the official CSC minutes. Parentage: not found.

disease_resistance.summary: Tagged with moderate resistance (MR) to leaf blast (listed as MR-LB) and to sheath-related and other listed diseases in the CRRI release table. The abbreviations BS, ShR and SB are not expanded in the source and have not been expanded here. No further disease evidence was found.

pest_resistance.summary: Highly tolerant to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot. Moderately tolerant to gall midge biotype 1 and stem borer (white ear heads). The same pest reaction profile is restated in the NRRI/CRRI variety compilation.

agronomic_details.yield: Release table lists 4.05 t/ha (equivalent to 4050 kg/ha). A separate entry on the same page gives 5.4-6 t/ha for this line. The two values have not been reconciled.
agronomic_details.stability: Not found in searched sources. No multi-environment stability data were found.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Stated ecology is aerobic/drought-prone adaptation (listed under 'Aerobic'). No agro-climatic zone data beyond the Odisha recommendation were found.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
CR Dhan 203 (Sachala) -- evidence below refers to this entry. Seednet name CR DHAN-303 -- evidence below refers to a separately notified entry (see note under RECOMMENDED STATES).

STRESS TOLERANCE / DISEASE AND PEST
- Listed as an aerobic-type variety with the code CR2717-10-IR84899-B-185 (IET), tagged in the CRRI release table with moderate resistance (MR) to leaf blast and sheath-related and other listed diseases; drought/aerobic adaptation is the stated ecology -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Highly tolerant to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot; moderately tolerant to gall midge biotype 1 and stem borer (white ear heads) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- The same pest reaction profile is restated in the NRRI/CRRI variety compilation, which also lists the variety under "Aerobic" -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- Disease abbreviations in the listing (MR-LB, BS, ShR, SB) are not expanded in the source; I have not expanded them. Drought tolerance is not explicitly scored for CR Dhan 203 in the pages found -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Duration 110 days, long slender (LS) grain, plant height 110 cm, listed yield 4.05 t/ha (release table) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- A separate entry in the NRRI/CRRI yield table gives 5.4-6 t/ha for this line -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ (second listing in same page)
- Cluster-demonstration or on-farm trial data specific to CR Dhan 203: No evidence found. The Jharkhand field-day page covers CR Dhan 202 and CR Dhan 305 only -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/2904
- The 2021 AICRP rice research group proceedings list CR Dhan 201 and CR Dhan 202 as zonal entries, not CR Dhan 203 -- https://icar-iirr.org/56%20ARGM%20Draft%20Proceedings%202021-%202.08.2021.pdf
- Root-trait observation: one NRRI compilation records maximum root number in CR Dhan 203 (60 roots per ...), truncated in the snippet -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses

GENETICS AND QTL
- Pedigree as printed in the NRRI compilation: CR2717-10-IR84899-B-185 (IET IR78877/IRRI132). The pedigree string is fragmentary in the snippet; treat it as unverified -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- Marker, QTL or MAS work on CR Dhan 203: No evidence found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Lead breeder name for CR Dhan 203: No evidence found in any search result.
- Developing institution: Central Rice Research Institute (CRRI), Cuttack, Odisha, listed as the developer in the CRRI release table -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Institutional naming: CRRI was renamed ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI) in 2015 per a secondary site; the CRRI release list is dated and the same varieties are credited to NRRI in other pages -- https://testbook.com/ias-preparation/central-rice-research-institute and https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Institution history (founded 1946, Cuttack, ICAR) -- https://icar-crri.in/directors-message/
- Research stations: Central Rainfed Upland Rice Research Station, Hazaribagh (Jharkhand) and Regional Rainfed Lowland Rice Research Station, Gerua (Assam) -- https://arch-india.org/institution/central-rice-research-institute
- Industry demand: CR Dhan 203 was among the top ten indented varieties in 2022-23 -- https://icar-crri.in/major-achievements/

CONTACT DETAILS
- No breeder contact found: No evidence found.
- Institute contact page, official email, phone or postal address for ICAR-CRRI/NRRI Cuttack: No evidence found in search results. The institute website appears as https://icar-crri.in/ (site pages returned; no contact page captured). The NRRI site is https://icar-nrri.in/.

PUBLICATIONS
- Authors not identified. (2020). Rice Varieties of NRRI: Yield, Quality, Special Traits and Tolerance to Biotic and Abiotic Stresses. Compilation/ResearchGate PDF (affiliation: Central Rice Research Institute) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- ICAR-CRRI, Cuttack (2025). CRRI varieties 1968-2024 (release list incl. CR Dhan 203). ICAR-CRRI report -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Peer-reviewed paper, thesis or KrishiKosh entry specific to CR Dhan 203: No evidence found.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- No seed dealer, NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK or SAU listing for CR Dhan 203 found: No evidence found.
- Seednet portal entry: No evidence found for CR DHAN-303 or CR Dhan 203 on seednet.gov.in in these searches.
- Search results for paddy seeds from dealers (IndiaMart, Flipkart, BigHaat, Krushidukan) were for other hybrid or basmati products and were discarded.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Odisha, per the CRRI release list for CR Dhan 203 -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Release year: the release table lists 2014 for CR Dhan 203, which differs from the 2015-10-12 year in the CSC record. Not reconciled. No gazette notification for CR Dhan 203 was found; the 2014 gazette found is for CR Dhan 303.
- CR DHAN-303 (Seednet name) -- evidence refers to a different, separately notified entry, not CR Dhan 203: CR Dhan 303 (CR 2649-7, IET 21589), notified 2014 (S.O. 1146(E), 25.04.2014) for Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and Odisha -- http://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Notified-Rice-Varieties.htm. It is an irrigated, 125-day semi-dwarf variety from Udaya x IET 16611, with 5.0-6.0 t/ha yield and moderate resistance to leaf blast, neck blast, sheath rot and tungro -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ and https://www.academia.edu/118613495/Production_Technology_for_rice_variety_CR_Dhan_303. These pages do not match the CR Dhan 203 (Sachala) code, parentage, ecology or duration, so they are not attributed to this record.

drought.details: CR Dhan 319 is a short-duration, drought-tolerant rice variety suitable for direct sown rainfed conditions, as well as irrigated and rainfed medium areas. A novel abiotic stress responsive gene, LOC_. Os06g10210 (OsCHI2), associated with drought tolerance, was isolated from this cultivar.

heat.details: The variety exhibits heat stress tolerance and has been included in screening for high temperature tolerance in rice genotypes, contributing to the development of abiotic tolerant rice varieties.

salinity.details: CR Dhan 319 is tolerant to coastal salinity.

flood.details: The variety is moderately tolerant to stagnant flooding.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: CR Dhan 501 (IET 19189), rice

Name note: the CSC/notification name and the Seednet name were both searched as "CR Dhan 501". No Seednet portal page for this variety came up in the results, so every finding below refers to the CR Dhan 501 name in general sources. Sources use "CR Dhan-501" and "CR DHAN-501" interchangeably.

STRESS TOLERANCE:
- Developed for medium/semi-deep waterlogged areas, and reported to withstand static waterlogging of about 50-75 cm depth -- https://www.deccanherald.com/india/rice-variety-developed-water-logged-2517121
- Rated highly tolerant to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot, and moderately tolerant to gall midge biotype 1 and white ear stem borer -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Described as lodging resistant and suitable for semi-deep and low-lying land -- https://www.sentinelassam.com/cities/guwahati-city/assam-scientists-develop-high-protein-climate-smart-rice-varieties-477392
- Flood-prone and waterlogged-area targeting reported in press coverage -- https://fasalkranti.in/cr-dhan-501/

DISEASE AND PEST:
- Resistant to neck blast; plant height about 135 cm -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Resistant to neck blast per the NRRI bulletin table -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/RB-37.pdf
- SRBSDV (virus) prevention measures discussed in regional press (Hindi) -- https://biharagro.com/crri-launches-cr-dhan-501-for-waterlogged-rice/
- Bihar notified-variety listing gives no disease data -- https://dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in/licence/Document/Variety.pdf (listing only)

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS:
- Duration about 152 days (NRRI/CRRI listings); about 155 days (press) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://biharagro.com/crri-launches-cr-dhan-501-for-waterlogged-rice/
- Yield potential 3.4 t/ha (listing); about 4.0 t/ha average (press) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://biharagro.com/crri-launches-cr-dhan-501-for-waterlogged-rice/
- Long bold grain (listing) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Assam RRL-RRS Gerua multi-location seed-sub-committee inclusion (recommended for Assam on Gerua trial performance) -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Characteristics-of-CR-Dhan-310-and-CR-Dhan-311_tbl2_338623089
- Not found: field-trial data from the AICRIP coordinated testing for this entry, beyond the summary listings above.

GENETICS AND QTL:
- Pedigree in the NRRI bulletin: segregating material of cross Ravana/Mahsuri -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/RB-37.pdf
- Pedigree in the NRRI listing: CR2008-111 (IET19189), with parent Savitri/Padmini. This conflicts with the bulletin's Ravana/Mahsuri pedigree; both are recorded, unresolved -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- No QTL or marker study found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION:
- Developing institution: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack, Odisha. Older sources call it Central Rice Research Institute (CRRI), Cuttack -- https://icar.org.in/node/1586 ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Released by CVRC in 2010 (listing) and notified under S.O. 283(E) dated 07.02.2011 for Uttar Pradesh and Assam -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; http://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Notified-Rice-Varieties.htm
- Station/testing: RRL-RRS Gerua (Hajo), Assam, under ICAR-NRRI -- https://www.sentinelassam.com/cities/guwahati-city/assam-scientists-develop-high-protein-climate-smart-rice-varieties-477392
- Lead breeder name: No evidence found after searching.

CONTACT DETAILS:
- Breeder or scientist names, emails, phones and postal address: No evidence found after searching. The institute's own site (icar-nrri.in) was the only official source located and was not searched for contact pages.

PUBLICATIONS:
- Authors not stated (2022). High yielding varieties and their package of practices (ICAR-NRRI bulletin RB-37). ICAR-NRRI bulletin -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/RB-37.pdf
- Authors not stated (n.d.). Rice Varieties of NRRI: Yield, Quality, Special Traits and Tolerance to Biotic and Abiotic Stresses. ResearchGate -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- Authors not stated (2025). ICAR-CRRI varieties 1968-2024 (release list). ICAR-CRRI -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- No peer-reviewed paper, KrishiKosh thesis or AICRP report specific to CR Dhan 501 was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY:
- Seed was distributed to select farmers in Odisha in the 2010-era coverage -- https://www.deccanherald.com/india/rice-variety-developed-water-logged-2517121
- No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK or dealer listing found. Seednet portal not reached. No evidence found after searching.

RECOMMENDED STATES:
- Uttar Pradesh and Assam (semi-deep water ecology) -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/RB-37.pdf ; http://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Notified-Rice-Varieties.htm
- Assam seed sub-committee inclusion -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Characteristics-of-CR-Dhan-310-and-CR-Dhan-311_tbl2_338623089

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: CR Dhan 601 (rice)

Name note: The CSC release minutes name is "CR Dhan 601". The Seednet name is "CR DHAN-601". I did not retrieve any Seednet portal page, so every item below refers to "CR Dhan 601" in the release-minute or institute-listing sense. Seed-portal status is unverified.

Identifiers: The variety code IET 18558 appears with the line codes CRG1190-1 and IC584245. Notification number SO.10-11/2010-SO-IV is dated 10-10-2010, which matches the year field. The parentage field was "Not specified", but the source gives Jaya/IR 64 as the cross, made at the CRRI Regional Rainfed Lowland Research Station, Gerua, Assam. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Listed as tolerant to cold, with a Boro ecology and 160-day duration (medium-slender, moderately tolerant to the listed pests). -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Abiotic stress tolerance is recorded as "minimal stress" on the Odisha varietal sheet, which conflicts with the cold-tolerance entry above. -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-601-english.pdf
- No drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence data found beyond the above.

DISEASE AND PEST
- Moderately resistant to leaf blast, brown spot, sheath rot, rice tungro virus, stem borer, leaf folder and green leaf hopper. The sheet describes it as moderately resistant to BL, BS, ShR, RTV, SB, GLH and LF. -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-601-english.pdf
- The CRRI list adds moderate resistance to neck blast and reaction data for bacterial leaf blight (BL), brown spot and related pests. -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- The NRRI variety table also lists a high level of resistance to neck blast for this line. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Released by the Central Sub-Committee on Crop Standards after high yield under Boro conditions at the 45th AICRIP workshop (08.04.2010). -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601
- Average yield of 7.2 t/ha, reported as 10.5% over IR 64, 9.3% over Krishna Hansa, 10.4% over local check and 17.7% over Gautam. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601
- Potential yield is listed as 5.6 t/ha (Odisha sheet and CRRI PDF) and as 7.8 t/ha on another CRRI snippet. These figures conflict and should be checked against the original minutes. -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-601-english.pdf ; https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- The NRRI table reports grain-quality and cooking traits (volume expansion, elongation and similar), with the variety among those showing higher values. -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Rice-Varieties-of-NRRI.pdf
- Suitable ecology is Boro rice area, season Boro, duration 160 days, semi-dwarf stature (about 90 cm), medium-slender grain. -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-601-english.pdf ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

GENETICS AND QTL
- No QTL, marker-assisted or molecular-diversity study specific to CR Dhan 601 was found. The only genetic information is the Jaya/IR 64 cross and line codes given under the Identifiers note above. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institute: Central Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, Odisha (now ICAR-National Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, per the institute's listing). The cross was made at the CRRI Regional Rainfed Lowland Research Station, Gerua, Assam. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601 ; https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- The institute's variety listing (CVRC; the release year is given as 2010) is at -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Breeder name: not found. The only named author in the search results is Sachin Rautaray (ICAR-Indian Institute of Water Management, Bhubaneswar), who wrote the 2012 note. This is not confirmed as the breeder. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601

CONTACT DETAILS
- Breeder: No breeder name or contact found.
- Institute contact (director, ICAR-CRRI Cuttack): Phone +91-671-2367757/67, EPBX +91-671-2367768-783, Fax +91-671-2367663, email directorcrricuttack@gmail.com. Address: ICAR-Central Rice Research Institute, Cuttack – 753006, Odisha. -- https://icar-crri.in/contact-us/
- Official site: Director, Central Rice Research Institute, ICAR, Cuttack (Odisha) 753006. Phone 91-0671-2367768-83, Fax 91-0671-2367663, E-mail director.crri@icar.gov.in and directorcrricuttack@gmail.com. -- https://crri.icar.gov.in/
- Regional station (Gerua/RRLRRS) contact: not found.
- Some third-party contact aggregators list other numbers and emails. These were not verified against official pages and are not included. -- https://www.indiacustomercare.com/national-rice-research-institute-nrri-contact-no-0671-236-7757

PUBLICATIONS
- Rautaray, S. (2012). Cold tolerant rice variety CR Boro Dhan 601. Indian Journal of Genetics and Plant Breeding 72(1):108-109 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601 (other authors not retrieved; DOI not found)
- Rice Varieties of NRRI: Yield, Quality, Special Traits and Tolerance to Biotic and Abiotic Stresses (NRRI variety analysis; authors and year not retrieved) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- ICAR-CRRI Rice varieties/hybrids developed during 1968 to 2025 (institute report; no author) -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- No KrishiKosh thesis, AICRIP annual-report entry or DOI-indexed trial paper specific to CR Dhan 601 was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- No evidence found from NSC, state seed corporations, KVKs, SAU sales or private dealers. Seednet status: not retrieved.
- Assam Seed Sub-Committee included CR Dhan 601 in its list of NRRI varieties for Assam, based on performance at the Gerua station. -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Characteristics-of-CR-Dhan-310-and-CR-Dhan-311_tbl2_338623089
- A Sentinel Assam report says the variety is for Ahu, Sali and Boro seasons, duration 115–145 days, yield 3.5–5.6 t/ha. -- https://www.sentinelassam.com/cities/guwahati-city/assam-scientists-develop-high-protein-climate-smart-rice-varieties-477392

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Orissa (Odisha), West Bengal and Assam, per the CVRC release record. -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- The state-list entry in the Bihar notified-variety document also records CR DHAN-601 among notified varieties (notification S.O. details not shown in the snippet). -- https://dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in/licence/Document/Variety.pdf

stress_confirmation_note: The drought details describe CR Dhan 807 as both drought-tolerant (high) and having 'low moisture stress tolerance', and the CR Dhan 416 URL is cited as drought evidence for a different variety, so the drought entry needs review.

drought.details: Described as a drought-tolerant upland/rainfed variety for Odisha and Bihar. Rated as moderately drought tolerant, with 29.02 q/ha under moderate drought versus 43.69 q/ha under normal conditions. The CRRI table lists moderate resistance (MR) to drought. Evidence refers to 'CR Dhan 108' rather than the Seednet form 'CR DHAN 108'. No physiological or molecular mechanism for drought tolerance was found in the digest.

heat.details: The NRRI press release states that the three NRRI releases (CR Dhan 108, 810 and 416) carry improved tolerance to high temperature and reduced water. The release does not give CR Dhan 108-specific scores, so the level cannot be graded. No mechanisms were found.

salinity.details: Not found in searched sources.

flood.details: Several articles describe a SwarnaSub1-derived line with 38 q/ha under flood or submergence stress. The evidence points to CR Dhan 810, not CR Dhan 108. No flood-tolerance evidence specific to CR Dhan 108 was found.

disease_resistance.summary: Moderate resistance (MR) to neck blast, leaf blast and sheath blight per the CRRI table entry. Krishi Jagran reports moderate resistance to leaf blast, neck blast and sheath blight. Evidence refers to 'CR Dhan 108'. A 'zinc 25.5 ppm / stem rot' text block was excluded because it is not clearly tied to CR Dhan 108. No resistance to other diseases was reported in the digest.

pest_resistance.summary: Planthopper: moderate resistance (CRRI table) and planthopper resistance (Krishi Jagran). Stem borer, gall midge and leaf folder: reported as tolerant (Khetivyapar and CRRI table, which describe tolerance to 'stem borer, gall midge, leaf folder and similar pests'). Pest-level grading was not given in the digest.

agronomic_details.yield: Reported yields vary by source: 34.46 q/ha in one source, 43.69 q/ha under normal conditions in another, and 3.2-3.9 t/ha in the CRRI table. Under moderate drought, 29.02 q/ha was reported.
agronomic_details.stability: Limited evidence. The drought-stress yield (29.02 q/ha) versus normal-condition yield (43.69 q/ha) indicates a reduction of about one-third under moderate drought. No multi-environment stability analysis was found in the digest.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Early-maturing, suited to early direct-seeded rainfed rice. Recommended for Odisha and Bihar. Listed among DSR-suited varieties in an agronomy guide. Specific agro-climatic zones were not given in the digest.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
I could not complete the research, so this is not an evidence digest. The web search tool failed on every attempt, so I have no sourced findings for CR Dhan 415 (Seednet name: CR Dhan - 405) under any heading.

What happened:
- My first batch of four searches (variety/release, breeder/institution, research papers, seed availability) timed out on the server side. The results were never returned.
- Every later attempt failed with "Server tool use limit exceeded," including a single retry.
- A few of my searches also returned no usable output, so I have nothing to attribute to this variety.

Because the searches did not return results, I have not written "No evidence found" under any heading. That phrase would wrongly suggest the searches ran and came back empty. Every heading (STRESS TOLERANCE, DISEASE AND PEST, AGRONOMY AND TRIALS, GENETICS AND QTL, BREEDER AND INSTITUTION, CONTACT DETAILS, PUBLICATIONS, SEED AVAILABILITY, RECOMMENDED STATES) is therefore unverified.

Suggested next steps:
1. Retry the four searches in a new session once the search quota resets, running them one at a time.
2. Check the Seednet portal (seednet.gov.in) directly under "PADDY (DHAN)" for "CR Dhan - 405" and the CSC notification for "CR Dhan 415."
3. Check the ICAR-NRRI site and the Central Rainfed Upland Rice Research Station for the breeder names and contact pages.
4. Search KrishiKosh (krishikosh.egranth.ac.in) for theses and papers using both names, "CR Dhan 415" and "CR Dhan 405," and "Kamesh IET 22097."

I can rerun the searches and write the full digest once the tool is available again.

seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Assam, Chhattisgarh and Uttar Pradesh; Irrigated
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: 1.	Intermediate grain shattering. 2.	Fertilizer responsive. 3.	Mid - Early maturity type. 4.	Normal seed rate.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: It is moderately resistant to leaf blast and RTV.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: It is resistant to stem borer (both dead heart and white ear heads), leaf folder and whorl maggot leaf.
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Three week before seed sowing, incorporate the well decomposed FYM into soil. Apply NPK @ 80:40:40 per hectare with 35% of nitrogenous fertilizer, full phosphorus & 50% potasic fertilizer as basal .

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: Central Rainfed Upland Rice Research Station (ICAR-National Rice Research Institute, Hazaribag (Jharkhand)
seednet_fields.Parentage:
Vandana/ IR 64
Vandana: Drought tolerant, deep rooted most popular upland rice variety developed at CRURRS, Hazaribag having yield QTLs under drought (qDTY2.3, and qDTY3.2), but poor in terms of grain quality.
IR 64: It is very popular variety cultivated in all over India, with vary high yield potential, having tolerance to major buiotic stresses and superior grain quality features.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Highly responsive to fertilizers with moderately high agronomic N use efficiency and suitable for both early and late planting
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics:
1.	Light green foliage
2.	Basal leaf sheath colour: green
3.	Flag leaf broad and semi-erect at flowering
4.	Intermediate stature
5.	Compact well exerted long panicle with distinct long slender grains and straw colour hull at maturity
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Resistant to blast moderately resistant to brown spot
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Fertilizer with 30 kg P2O5 & 30 kg MOP/ha as basal dose and 60 kg N/ha in two splits, half at 20 DAS and the second half at 35-40 DAS synchronizing with rains

disease_resistance.summary: Moderately resistant (MR) to leaf blast, neck blast, brown spot, sheath blight, sheath rot, stem borer, leaf folder and green leaf hopper (GLH); grain type MS. Evidence is from the CRRI released-variety listing and the RKB Odisha varietal sheet, which together support the MR ratings. The RKB sheet names only leaf blast, brown spot, sheath rot, stem borer, leaf folder and GLH. Unconfirmed: the CRRI released-variety page lists high tolerance to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot, and moderate tolerance to gall midge biotype 1 and white ear-head stem borer. This text sits adjacent to the variety row in extraction, so it is likely but not confirmed for ANKIT.

pest_resistance.summary: Moderately resistant (MR) to stem borer, leaf folder and green leaf hopper (GLH), per the CRRI listing and the RKB Odisha varietal sheet.
